concept.title: Extracting Agreement Data Using Intelligent Discovery

conbody.p: You can use the Intelligent Discovery feature to automatically extract key data from third-party contract documents. Intelligent Discovery scans third-party documents, and recognizes and maps important metadata and clauses to the Conga CLM. You can control the visibility of the Intelligent Discovery feature in X-Author for Contracts Advanced. For more details, see CLM for Administrators.

Previously, on importing an offline agreement, you need to manually find clauses and fields and mark them. Intelligent Discovery uses pre-trained artificial intelligence-based clauses and fields and uses an AI model to recognize the words that denote the clauses or fields in the third-party document.
